nativeSourceCamera.method: Full verified2m float source (LN02), all crossed cells/diagonals for continuous intro/replay/outro legs; exact triangular LOS at all encoded timestamps.350m unchanged. Additional lifts of the existing pure camera only raise the proved base legs.

meshApproximation.method: Same PROJ geographic coordinates/triangular mesh interpolation; original rounded2m grid versus derived rounded5m grid. Approximation difference is not source survey precision or road-centre survey accuracy.

performance.method: One warm-up excluded then3steady trials per mode/configuration, same26point geographic route and marker/grade/pacing settings. Original1km2m scene versus expanded5m scene includes camera/coverage changes. Extended low/high differ only photographic detail. CPU frame submission+destination copy is not GPU elapsed time. Native process memory measured separately.
